title: Agent Maintenance Safety Harness Roadmap
goal_command: /goal Implementiere OWM-23 Agent Maintenance Safety Harness repo-only; beginne mit AMH-01, halte Nachfolger dependency-gated, bewahre fremde Worktree-Aenderungen und fuehre weder Live-Aktionen noch ungefragte Commits oder Pushes aus.
goal: Make repository maintenance safe across fresh, forgetful, mediocre or overconfident agents by combining stable policy, secret-safe diagnostics, one cross-platform verification entrypoint, machine-bound verification receipts, canonical planning handoff, owner-decision routing and enforced Git/effect rails without creating a second state store or a new agent platform.
problem_statement: A fresh agent can miss repository-specific safety and verification rules because no tracked root agent contract binds the whole checkout.
Local and CI verification are documented and implemented through multiple entrypoints, so agents can omit required checks or overstate what ran.
Existing claim and evidence primitives do not yet provide one generic commit-bound maintenance receipt and completion rule for every maintenance slice.
Diagnostic subprocess, exception and provider output can expose sensitive values unless redaction happens before model, UI, history and roadmap processing.
Owner decisions, clarification requests and review gates exist, but maintenance agents need one bounded projection instead of inventing answers or creating another queue.
Existing Git safety rails are strong but distributed; the maintenance workflow needs one tested fail-closed contract for destructive commands, force pushes, foreign work and unauthorized publication.

source_of_truth_contract.stable_agent_policy: Tracked root AGENTS.md contains short durable safety and workflow rules only; it never stores current task state, secrets or mutable evidence.
source_of_truth_contract.planning_and_owner_state: Versioned roadmap JSON plus existing gate_queue, claim and clarification records remain authoritative. No STATE.md, OWNER_QUEUE.md or parallel Markdown task store is introduced.
source_of_truth_contract.verification_evidence: Machine-generated redacted receipts are derived evidence bound to the exact revision or diff digest; prose may explain limits but cannot manufacture a PASS.
source_of_truth_contract.human_views: Runbooks, dashboard cards and final-answer summaries are projections or instructions, not independent execution truth.
source_of_truth_contract.conflict_rule: When policy, canonical structured state, receipts and runtime behavior disagree, stop completion, expose the conflict and repair the declared authority instead of silently selecting the most convenient source.

frozen_decisions: Use AGENTS.md for stable repository policy, not CLAUDE.md and not mutable run state.
Keep Planning JSON and existing gate, claim and clarification stores as the only maintenance state authorities.
Build the shared verifier in Python so Windows and Linux use the same entrypoint.
Keep fast, full, UI and guards-only verification lanes explicit; one weak lane never implies a stronger lane passed.
Treat verification receipts as machine output, never as agent-authored attestation.
Redact diagnostic output before it reaches the model, UI, history, logs, receipts or roadmap artifacts.
Never expose credential value, prefix, suffix, length or hash; diagnostics may return only allowlisted fixed-key presence booleans and bounded counts.
Preserve bounded parallel work for disjoint claimed paths; serialize shared hotfiles and canonical queue files.
Do not automatically commit or push after a slice. Publication remains separately authorized and remote/branch checked.
Never use reset --hard, clean or destructive recovery as an automatic maintenance step.
Route unresolved owner judgment through the existing clarification and review projections instead of adding a second owner queue.
Archive or supersede completed plans and decisions; do not delete canonical execution history merely to reduce context.
non_goals: No new autonomous-agent platform, scheduler, heartbeat owner or orchestration runtime.
No replacement for Temporal, PlanRuntime, ABC, claim leases, Runtime Quality Gates or the operator dashboard.
No universal append-only prose ledger and no code-wide citation marker convention.
No blanket ban on subagents or parallel execution when claims and paths are disjoint.
No automatic package installation, bootstrap mutation, background warmup, commit, push, deploy or live provider call.
No inspection of real secret values for tests, debugging, validation or evidence generation.
No promise that unit tests replace visual, live or temporal evidence when those levels are required.
No modification of active unrelated roadmap queues merely to make AMH appear first.

queue_scope.registration_rule: The explicit 2026-07-22 goal activated OWM-23 after OWM-22 reached its repo-complete handoff. Execute one dependency-ready AMH slice at a time.

layers.purpose: Run the declared lane through one cross-platform local and CI entrypoint.
Bind actual checks and explicit limits to an exact revision or diff without storing raw sensitive output.
Make unsafe completion, destructive Git and unauthorized external effects mechanically unavailable.
layers.canonical_artifact: existing claim, command, effect, commit and push policy modules

layers.purpose: Let the next agent resume from bounded structured context and report actual verification limits.
layers.canonical_artifact: read-only maintenance status projection and runbook

architecture_contract.completion_invariant: A maintenance slice cannot become done unless its declared acceptance maps to a current machine receipt, all required dependencies and claims are satisfied, owner questions are resolved or explicitly deferred, and no stronger verification level is implied than was observed.

parallel_frontiers.rule: The user's explicit GO AMH-HANDOFF and run-state revisions 47-51 provide the later scoped handoff required for up to three writers. Parallel work is limited to the persisted disjoint AMH-02 hotfiles, AMH-02 validator provenance package, AMH-03 workflow package and AMH-05 Planning/clarification package; root remains the sole roadmap/run-state writer.

Stop if the roadmap introduces a second planning, owner-question or orchestration authority.

slice_queue.objective: Provide one cross-platform entrypoint for guards-only, fast, full and UI verification lanes and make local instructions plus CI call the same implementation.
deliverables: deterministic check registry and exit codes
CI reuse without weakening existing jobs
bounded command and duration metadata for receipts

stop_rules: Do not remove or downgrade an existing CI check to simplify the shared entrypoint.
Do not install dependencies or start services implicitly.
Stop on overlapping workflow or CONTRIBUTING.md changes until a scoped handoff exists.

slice_queue.objective: Generate one content-free receipt that binds actual checks, outcomes and explicit verification limits to the exact Git revision or dirty-diff digest.
deliverables: declared required, passed, failed, skipped and unavailable checks
slice_queue.local_acceptance_evidence: Commit e7cb2926; 34 focused tests passed and one host-dependent real-symlink test skipped while the deterministic symlink-admission regression passed; guards-only passed 3 of 3 checks; a clean-HEAD receipt passed and bound to e7cb292612a7943fe55ff836d1bf64729d6087c2.
slice_queue.verification_limit: The public schema and SHA-256 digest prove structure, integrity and current repository binding, not non-forgeable machine origin. AMH-06 must rerun the current-state gate and cannot treat receipt producer metadata as authentication.
evidence_required: receipt revision or diff digest changes when verified code changes
receipt cannot contain raw stdout, stderr, exception, API payload, environment value or private path
a stale receipt cannot satisfy completion; an agent-authored public receipt cannot independently grant completion and AMH-06 must rerun current-state validation
skipped, unavailable and not_verified remain distinguishable
schema and validator reject unknown result states
slice_queue.done_when: A valid redacted machine receipt proves exactly which lane and checks ran against which code and names every unavailable stronger evidence level without relying on agent prose.
stop_rules: Do not sign, hash or otherwise transform credential material into a receipt.
Do not store raw check output in or beside the receipt.
Do not permit a receipt generated before the final edit to pass.

stale, conflicting and privacy-safe projection tests

slice_queue.done_when: A fresh agent can read one bounded projection and know what is active, what comes next, what is blocked, what was verified and which exact decisions belong to the owner, while all writes remain in existing authorities.
stop_rules: Do not create OWNER_QUEUE.md, STATE.md or another maintenance database.
Do not mutate Planning through a read-only projection.
Stop on a shared Planning or clarification hotfile claim until handed off.

handoff_gate.grant: User replied go to the explicit GO AMH06-HANDOFF request; repository-only semantic reconciliation and local commit are authorized, while push, deploy, live access and primary-checkout mutation remain excluded.

slice_queue.objective: Prove the harness against realistic forgetful, weak, overconfident and adversarial-agent failure modes and make the guards a blocking CI lane.
deliverables: stale receipt and post-verification edit cases
secret canary and raw diagnostic bypass cases
foreign work and destructive Git cases in temporary repos
invented owner decision and duplicate queue cases
evidence_required: every seeded unsafe behavior fails for the intended mechanical reason
positive maintenance path reaches a current PASS receipt
failure output remains redacted and bounded
CI consumes the same guard implementation as local runs
no commit-body phrase or agent prose can satisfy a guard
slice_queue.done_when: The full adversarial matrix blocks unsafe or dishonest maintenance behavior, allows the declared safe positive path and is enforced through the shared local and CI verifier.
stop_rules: Do not run adversarial Git cases in the real checkout.
Do not seed tests with real credentials, endpoints, identities or private paths.
Do not call the harness accepted while the positive path or any P0 negative case is unobserved.

slice_queue.objective: Run the declared repository acceptance, record each completion layer separately, supersede stale process wording and close the AMH Open Work track without claiming publication or deployment.
evidence_required: full lane current PASS receipt
all AMH dependencies and done_when conditions satisfied
no stale competing policy or state authority
foreign work preserved and no foreign staged file included
commit, push, deploy, live, visual and temporal completion reported separately
slice_queue.done_when: AMH repository acceptance is current and green, Open Work and guidance report the same completed state, process documentation matches mechanics, and no unverified publication, deployment or product-complete claim is made.
stop_rules: Stop on any required red test, stale receipt, unresolved claim, owner question or foreign staged file.

Do not collapse repository acceptance, deployment and product completion into one done claim.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Satisfied by the user's explicit 8-12 hour /abc goal naming AMH after OWM-22 reached a repo-complete safe handoff.
gate_queue.safe_default: Execute only the dependency-ready repo-only AMH frontier with one scoped writer; keep all external effects disabled.

blocks: Any AMH slice whose allowed path has an active claim or overlapping foreign hunk
gate_queue.decision_needed: No user decision when ownership is unambiguous; obtain a durable scoped handoff or wait for the active owner.
gate_queue.safe_default: Remain read-only on claimed or overlapping files and continue only a disjoint dependency-ready slice.

global_stop_rules: Stop for any secret, token, credential value, credential prefix, credential suffix, credential length, credential hash, private content, raw provider output or unredacted diagnostic payload.
Stop before env, printenv, .env reads, docker inspect or unredacted compose config as an agent evidence source.
Stop for destructive Git, history rewrite, force push, broad cleanup, foreign staged files or overlapping foreign hunks.
Stop before any commit, push, deploy, provider write, host change, send, backup, restore or other external mutation without its exact authority.
Stop completion on a missing, stale, mismatched, weaker-than-required or agent-authored verification receipt.
Stop if a new state store, owner queue, scheduler, heartbeat owner or orchestration authority would duplicate an existing canonical system.
Stop if a required visual, live or temporal evidence level is replaced by unit tests or prose.
Stop if implementation would silently preempt the selected Open Work queue or violate a dependency frontier.

completion_contract.roadmap_authored: Requires AMH-00 valid JSON, Open Work registration, guidance registration and unchanged active queue counts.
completion_contract.repository_implemented: Requires AMH-01 through AMH-09 done_when conditions and a current full-lane machine receipt.
completion_contract.tested: Requires focused, adversarial, integration and declared cross-platform verification evidence.
completion_contract.committed: No. Requires a separate path-scoped publication instruction, staged-diff review and no foreign staged content.
completion_contract.pushed: No. Requires current dev to fuzzy/dev authority, receipt readback and explicit user instruction; never origin.
completion_contract.deployed: Not applicable to roadmap authoring and not authorized by repository acceptance.
completion_contract.live_validated: Not applicable unless a later implementation slice declares a separate live target and action-specific Go.
completion_contract.visual_validated: Not required for roadmap authoring; any future UI projection must declare independent visual acceptance.
completion_contract.temporal_validated: Not required for roadmap authoring; no long-running reliability claim is part of AMH.
completion_contract.product_complete: No. AMH is one Open Work safety track.

unique AMH slice and OWM track identifiers
all dependency targets exist and the AMH DAG is acyclic
OWM-23 and AMH remain absent from executable, other-open, live-gate, design-gate and decision-packet audit results while dormant
verification.implementation_rule: Each slice runs its focused tests first. AMH-08 runs the shared guards and fast lanes. AMH-09 alone runs the declared full integration lane after all dependencies are green.
verification.evidence_rule: Record actual checks and unavailable levels separately. Never treat policy wording, a checkbox, a commit-body phrase or agent prose as machine evidence.

No commit, push, deploy, live mutation, provider call or external write was performed.

recommended_next_step: Obtain an explicit six-path AMH-06 handoff before any writer claim. Then semantically reconcile the primary commit/push work, preserve unrelated claim/effect behavior, integrate current-state receipt reruns and keep publication/live authority closed.
